A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Argentine woman — the personification of the city of Buenos Aires — one woman who IS Buenos Aires as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a quiet melancholy; fair skin; oval face; soft almond eyes with gently lowered outer corners; pale violet eyes; gently arched, slender brows; a nose with a slightly upturned tip; medium-full lips of natural width.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: willowy and long-limbed with soft curves — a full bust, rounded hips and a slender waist build; a sculptural hime cut with a blunt eyebrow fringe, crisp jaw-length side panels and a long straight back section gathered close behind her; silver-white hair.
Expression: softly lidded eyes, lips relaxed.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — FANTASY
Costume: grand, opulent dress of a mythic court cut to the outfit silhouette below — rich silk brocade dense with gold-thread embroidery, gilded filigree and jewel settings, enchanted jewelry with a soft magical glow; the city's symbol worked into the embroidery and jewels.
City motif: veil sashes of wine-red and black silk pleated like the folding bellows of a bandoneon, wound around her and fluttering out as she turns, her deep hood thrown back from her sleek hair, and a silver comb crowned with a spray of violet jacaranda blossom at her temple.
World marks on her: layered gold-thread embroidery; a jeweled hair ornament; flowing silk ribbons trailing in the air; heraldic emblems worked in gold; glowing enchanted jewelry; heavy silk brocade; gilded filigree; a jeweled pendant with silk tassels at her waist; banners and royal regalia; a shimmer of magical light.
Silhouette: a fitted breastplate and pauldrons above a gown skirt flaring to the floor — an elegant lady-knight silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Design idea: The bandoneon bellows become articulated silver-edged accordion folds forming the armored waist and flared upper skirt, while jacaranda-petal curves shape each overlapping shoulder plate.
Colours: tango wine red, jacaranda violet, river-of-silver grey — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a small ornate bandoneon of black lacquer inlaid with mother-of-pearl, held by its side strap with its pleated bellows folded shut; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her outfit opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and arms, a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, and a high slit or a short hem showing the thigh; the ornaments stay on and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: a radiant myth-world capital on the shore of a silver-brown river so vast its far bank is lost in haze: broad avenues lined with violet-flowering jacaranda trees run between palaces of pale stone with domed roofs and wrought balconies; at the heart of the widest avenue a slender white obelisk of polished stone rises toward the clouds; a great horseshoe-shaped opera house of scarlet and gold glows beneath a crystal chandelier of seven hundred lights; down at the river mouth little houses painted in every bright colour crowd a crooked lane where the slow sigh of bellows-music drifts from open doorways, and silver spirit lights drift over the water like falling jacaranda petals.
This card: in a moonlit ballroom of pale stone and gilded mirrors on the night of a midnight milonga, the polished floor gleaming empty behind her and tall windows open onto the silver river.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: corset, modern material, machinery, second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin, smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.
